weapons.name: Shard Lance
weapons.desc: Crystal shards that slip through one shield layer.

weapons.name: Heavy Shard
weapons.desc: A crystal the size of a crew member, fired at the enemy. Slips through one shield layer.

weapons.name: Prism Beam
weapons.desc: A long sweep of split light that ignores one shield layer.

weapons.name: Resonator Bomb
weapons.desc: Shakes a room until its machinery cracks.

drones.name: Facet Drone
drones.desc: A spinning crystal that fires piercing light.

augments.name: Crystal Lattice Hull
augments.desc: Living crystal laced through the hull: a 2-point super shield at the start of every fight.

events.text: A Glassborn trader floats beside a raft of humming crystals. "Weapons that sing," it says. "Fair prices, for friends."

effect.text: It hums softly in the weapons bay.
It spins happily in the drone bay.
They chime at each other for a minute. The trader gifts you a crystal lattice for your hull.

events.text: A hollow asteroid lined with crystals that glow when your lights touch them.

fail.text: A crystal cracks and shatters your forward plating.
